about: Motion spec as data for the Amplify river, orbs, basin and service host (task e0cabe57). One row per animation inventory row: what moves, the record that drives it, its trigger, start/end, stop condition, the code that declares it (code: file + a substring of each declaring line) and, per traced part, the check each drawn axis must pass. tools/motion/spec.mjs fails when a declaration in plugin/**/*.qml is claimed by no row, when an anchor matches no declaration, or when a part has no Trace hook. tools/motion/follow.mjs reads this file and an AMPLIFY_TRACE=1 log. Kinds and options are documented at the top of follow.mjs.

rows.stop: speed 0, !animate or !visible: the water clock stops. It steps on a Timer every waterStepMs (at most 4 steps/s), never on the frame clock (task aa5e593d)

The same clock paces the orb eases (orbs-orb): every 125 ms while one runs, so a window draws at most 8 frames a second (task 118f6917)
